week_headline: Coffee gets another moment in the health spotlight as studies link heavy consumption to liver protection

claims.verdict: The core finding here is actually well-supported — multiple large studies and meta-analyses do show that regular coffee drinkers have meaningfully lower rates of liver cirrhosis and liver cancer (hepatocellular carcinoma). The catch is the source: NaturalNews.com has a history of sensationalising legitimate science, so the framing may overstate certainty or strip out important context like the fact that coffee is not a treatment and cannot reverse existing liver damage. The relationship is real and encouraging, but 'high consumption' needs a caveat — most benefit is seen at 2-4 cups a day, and very high intake carries its own risks for some people.
claims.verdict_highlight: Real link, but coffee is not a liver cure
sources: BMJ Open — Poole et al. (2017) umbrella review of coffee and health outcomes
Journal of Hepatology — Kennedy et al. meta-analysis on coffee and cirrhosis risk
World Journal of Gastroenterology — Sang et al. on coffee and hepatocellular carcinoma
NHS — guidance on coffee and liver health
NIH National Cancer Institute — coffee and cancer research summaries
claims.global_opinion: In the UK and across much of Europe, health authorities have acknowledged the liver-protective signal from coffee research while stopping short of making formal dietary recommendations around it. In the US, the FDA and major cancer institutions treat the evidence as promising but not conclusive enough to advise therapeutic use. In Japan, where both green tea and coffee consumption are high and liver cancer rates are closely studied, researchers have explored similar associations, though cultural preference for tea means coffee findings get less public traction there.
claims.brit_take: Turns out the office coffee machine may be doing more good than we thought — though HR probably won't start prescribing it just yet.
claims.claim: Study : High coffee consumption associated with lower risk of liver cancer , cirrhosis – NaturalNews . com
